_comment: Sample settings.json for public consumers of dotty's plugin-install harness. Real settings.json lives in dotty-private (gitignored from public surface). Copy the blocks you want into your own settings.json. Hooks and the statusline are NOT registered by path here — they ship inside the enabled plugins (installed and enabled separately, e.g. via `claude plugin marketplace add` / `install` / `enable`) and the harness installs the statusline to a fixed path. TODO: set VAULT_ROOT to your Obsidian vault (the vault-aware hooks fail-open and silently disable themselves without it), and swap work-lifecycle/estate-hooks for your own plugin marketplace and plugin names if you're not using the operator's.
